title: Swimming
info: Swimming is a skill and a sport. Lessons with a teacher are the safe way to learn.
Floating on your back can help if you are tired, but it is not a substitute for a life jacket in a boat.

questions.q: The safe way to learn to swim is

options: Left on the shore as a pillow

questions.q: If you are tired in the water
options: Float or hold the side and call for help
Only your hands on the pool floor
